definition: Beloved — the separated woman, the poem's voice. In Ghatakarpara, pramadā is the separated beloved (proṣitapramadā) whose lament constitutes the sandeśa-kāvya's first half.

sources.claim: proṣitapramadayedam udyate (this, the separated beloved, arises)

translations.note: 'Beloved' captures the affection; 'woman' is too flat.
